Hand-off. Site: MyHeritage, 1855 Massachusetts State Census, access reported as subscription. The researcher's subscriptions on file include MyHeritage. Log id: log_001. ---

Open this search:
https://www.myheritage.com/research/collection-20822/1855-massachusetts-state-census?s=1&formId=master&formMode=1&useTranslation=1&exactSearch=&p=1&action=query&view_mode=card&qname=Name+fn.Josiah+fnmo.1+ln.Barnes+lnmsrs.false&qevents-event1=Event+et.birth+ey.1818&qevents=List

- It ranks results rather than filtering them, so a large number of hits is normal.

FamilySearch holds the same 1855 census collection, so it can also be searched there through search-records.

Once you upload the capture, I will go through the results and pick out the likely matches.

I searched the 1855 Massachusetts State Census on MyHeritage for Josiah Barnes, born around 1818, and the search returned two people. The strong match is a Josiah Barnes born about 1818 in Massachusetts and living in Lexington, Middlesex County, in 1855. He is listed with Lucy (about 1821), Henry (about 1844) and Mary (about 1847), who may be his wife and children. The second, living in Lowell and born in New Hampshire about 1817, is unlikely to be him. Both are index entries, so the original census page still needs to be checked.

Next, please open the Lexington record, save its full page as a PDF and upload it so the details can be recorded as evidence.
